individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked area/bar chart showing median state frequency across continuous Pol II ChIP-seq bins, analogous to a line plot summarizing a continuous trend; overlaying individual promoter values is impractical and not required.
Each row of the single-molecule stack already represents an individual DNA molecule, so individual data underlying the state frequencies is directly displayed.
Same stacked area representation as panel A across continuous Pol II ChIP-seq bins; individual points not required for this plot type.
Same single-molecule stack representation as panel B, directly showing individual molecules.
Box plot; box plots inherently display the data distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points (though outlier points are also shown here).
Box plot; exempt from requiring overlaid individual points (outlier points are also shown here).

error-bars-defined.explanation: Stacked area/bar chart of median state frequencies with no error bars displayed.
Single-molecule stack plot with color-coded sidebar frequencies; no error bars present.
Same as panel A, no error bars present.
Same as panel B, no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The middle line of the box represents the median. The box displays the interquartile range (IQR), 25th to 75th percentile. Whiskers represent a distance of 1.5 x IQR.
